units.source_text: 摄津国的国守来迎接了，

en.t: The governor of Settsu Province came to welcome them,

units.source_text: 其招待之隆重，远非其他大臣参拜神社时可比。

en.t: and the magnificence of his reception far surpassed anything offered when other ministers came to worship at the shrine.
The Lady of Akashi felt deeply embarrassed:

units.source_text: 如果照旧去参拜，则我这微贱之身所献菲薄供品，毫不足数，一定不入神明之目；

en.t: If I go on to worship as planned, the meager offerings presented by someone as humble as I am will count for nothing and surely will not catch the deity's eye;

units.source_text: 如果就此折回，则又不成体统。

en.t: but if I turn back now, that too would be improper.

units.source_text: 考虑之下，今天还不如先在难波浦停泊，至少举行一下祓禊也好。

en.t: After thinking it over, she decided it would be better to anchor at Naniwa Bay for the day and at least perform a purification rite.
So she ordered the boat to head toward Naniwa Bay.
